method.pr_heads: git fetch '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/origin/pr/*' (237 refs); every open PR head object verified present locally; zero drift vs GitHub API head SHAs
method.merge_state: git merge-tree --write-tree (non-destructive, object-only); intermediate train states materialised with git commit-tree
method.supersession: git merge-base --is-ancestor between open PR heads (exact containment, not heuristic)
method.no_mutation: no merge, rebase, push to any PR branch, close, undraft, or delete performed

structural_findings.finding: 46 of 129 open PRs fork from 127ffaff78b230dff7334ad692c382b66d1d1287, not from current main.
structural_findings.evidence: git merge-base(head, 67e29bd) == 127ffaff for exactly those 46. Main carries 72 commits after 127ffaff touching 242 files.
structural_findings.consequence: All 46 conflict against main (111-116 conflicted paths each). The CONFLICT set and the stale-fork set are the same 46 PRs, exactly.

structural_findings.finding: codex/external-worker-hardening-v1 is a 132-commit / 293-file branch that has never had a pull request, yet 15 open PRs are based on it.
structural_findings.evidence: git ls-remote tip 8ad3be07eb27087acb67704fdf463ecb95b64505; merge-base with main 127ffaff; no ref under refs/pull/*/head resolves to it; not an ancestor of main.
structural_findings.consequence: Those 15 PRs' diffs are measured against unreviewed content. Their GitHub 'files changed' understates what reaching main would introduce.

structural_findings.finding: Five open PRs independently define a competing host-authority type; they mutually conflict.
structural_findings.evidence: #460 and #474 each define AuthEpoch; #470 defines VerifiedPrincipal; #472/#486/#490 define CapabilityGeneration; #489 defines AuthEpoch+PrincipalScope+VerifiedPrincipal; #488 is a second full G1-G4 spine. Pairwise merge-tree: #488x#489 conflict on 7 files, #460x#489 on 8, #486x#488 on 7.
structural_findings.consequence: Exactly the multi-identity-fence hazard issue #477 was opened to prevent. At most one may be promoted whole.
No authority spine is currently promotable. The green authority-adjacent PRs (#482, #486) are capability-generation only, not the full spine.

structural_findings.evidence: Both heads are 33b74ce6a7f4446303adbcb07dddd2913473108f with identical tree 0b7b1b03c0f1. Branches claude/external-worker-gate-4-zj3elc and claude/external-worker-gate-5-prod-surface point at the same object.

structural_findings.finding: The hosted gate is a single job for most PRs.
structural_findings.evidence: Of 34 PRs with observed checks, 31 have exactly one check run named 'desktop'. Ten workflows exist in main but only 'desktop' runs on most PRs.
structural_findings.consequence: Green CI here is weak evidence; it does not exercise packaged, live-provider, or isolated-VM claims.

structural_findings.finding: 20 open PRs cite a commit SHA in their body that is not an ancestor of their current head.
structural_findings.evidence: Contextual SHA extraction ('head/commit/base/at <sha>'), Actions run-ids excluded, resolved via git rev-parse against the fetched object store.
structural_findings.consequence: PR bodies cannot be trusted as provenance without re-derivation.

structural_findings.finding: No open PR contains content already byte-identical in main.
structural_findings.evidence: For all 129, files_vs_main_tip is non-empty and head_is_ancestor_of_main is false; zero pure no-ops.
structural_findings.consequence: No PR can be closed on grounds of already being merged.
